currentParagraphText: “Please follow me through the teleporter,” the head priest said, motioning toward it.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Please follow me through the teleporter,” the head priest said, motioning toward it.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Using a teleporter with an unknown destination seems highly unwise, especially when in territory I do not find particularly friendly,” Jake said, staring down at the priest. He’d only slightly let off on Presence while he kept unleashing his aura, fully aware of the mental pressure he was putting on everyone present.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Perhaps it was partly true, as they had more likely than expected him to be more injured after the Ell’Hakan fight than he actually was. It was thus highly probable they had wanted to make more preparations before Jake visited that they simply didn’t have time to.
